intro: The Partially Filled Vessel is an enchanted container used to transport blessed moonwell water across Teldrassil. Given to young night elf initiates by Tenaron Stormgrip in Aldrassil, it carries water drawn from Shadowglen toward the settlement of Dolanaar.

p: Within the boughs of Aldrassil, initiates of the kaldorei collect blessed waters from the secluded moonwell of Shadowglen. Tenaron Stormgrip pours that pure sample into this specialized vessel, preparing it for travel across the World Tree. The vessel remains only partially filled because its journey has merely begun; more sacred waters from across Teldrassil must eventually be gathered to tend to the island's health.

Carrying the vessel requires traveling south through the valley's gates and following the cobblestone roads west to Dolanaar. The journey marks a young adventurer's departure from the protected nursery of Shadowglen out into the broader wilds of Teldrassil. At Dolanaar's central moonwell, Corithras Moonrage takes custody of the vessel to direct the next phase of the ritual.
